_comment: DEPLOYMENT NOTE: hellouchit.com serves from GitHub Pages behind Cloudflare,
so this file is INERT — none of these headers reach visitors today. It is
kept correct so a future move to Vercel is a no-op rather than an outage.
The headers that actually apply in production are Cloudflare Transform Rules;
docs/security-headers.md is the source of truth and mirrors the values here.
CSP NOTE: script-src dropped 'unsafe-inline'. Every diagnostic's
Diag.run({...}), every decision tree's window.TREE = {...}, the GA snippet
and every onclick/onerror handler now live in external .js (js/pages/,
js/analytics.js) or are wired via addEventListener — see git history for
the migration scripts (scripts/migrate-inline-*.mjs).
style-src still carries 'unsafe-inline'. ~30 pages keep page-scoped CSS in
a <style> block (normal practice, but still inline for CSP purposes), plus
~280 one-off style="..." attributes that weren't common enough to justify
a utility class (see css/site.css's Utilities section for the ones that
were). A nonce-based policy requires per-request header generation, which
no static host can do; a hash-based one needs a distinct header per page,
which the single sitewide Cloudflare Transform Rule can't produce either.
Closing this fully means moving every page's <style> block to an external
stylesheet and finishing the attribute-to-utility-class pass — real work,
not done here.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; script-src 'self' https://www.googletagmanager.com https://static.cloudflareinsights.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' https://*.google-analytics.com https://analytics.google.com https://*.analytics.google.com https://*.googletagmanager.com https://stats.g.doubleclick.net https://www.google.com https://cloudflareinsights.com; upgrade-insecure-requests
